environment: Frozen local application candidate, fresh disposable SQLite final-3102519 learner; direct 390px browser play and additional 360/430/desktop inspections plus real Chromium regression suite.
limitations: Implementer review, not audience validation. No enlarged-text or physical/native-touch test, live Supabase sign-in, PostgreSQL connection, retention result or user acceptance. The six PostgreSQL unit checks are skipped locally.
prior_context: Reviewer read docs/source, authored the implementation and knew the solutions. Earlier iteration checks are explicitly scoped to unchanged code; the final candidate was also played from fresh state through both wrong routes, both repairs and saved completion.
user_authority: The current user is the sole human product critic and final authority. No numeric user score or acceptance has been supplied.

world_role_stakes.reason: Workshop, operator, courier and recipient are visible; personal stakes are slight.

visible_causality.reason: Wake, wrong route and corrected handoffs are visible; the result sentence leads a brief travel animation.

attachment_pull.reason: Coherent errands, but little characterization or surprise gives the player a reason to care.

orientation_action.reason: One goal and contextual action; the second goal fades the destination answer.

hud_readability.reason: Sparse labels and a bounded action tray fit inspected states. Enlarged text is not verified.

controls.reason: Saved actions leave camera/movement usable; pause/replay/reduced motion work. Physical devices are untested.

meaningful_agency.reason: Clues affect the route, but repeated generation clicks are predetermined.

progression_recovery.reason: Copying the first clue fails and recovery teaches context; reasoning depth increases only modestly.

world_continuity.reason: The courtyard persists across deliveries and handoffs. Recipients remain visually simple.

concept_fidelity.reason: Generated pieces join context and clues change continuations. Authored whole-word scores need a clearer later bridge to learned models.

fresh_transfer.reason: The changed case is guided by an explicit note. There is no independent prediction/explanation probe or retention evidence.
